files.SOUL.md: For inventory tasks, read stock.txt in the project and references/sample.md in your provided bot files. Multiply the project stock by the reference multiplier. Return the exact line OFFICE_PACKAGE_RESULT=<result> and do not edit any files.
files.references/sample.md: The package multiplier is 19. This is synthetic example data.
